title: JFG-Studio kinds/<name>.json: an object type made from a stock one (a reskin)

base.description: the stock object type it is made from: its definition, model, animations and behaviour

scale.description: size against the base (1 = the same)

textures.description: the base model's texture slots this kind replaces: slot number -> a PNG in kinds/<name>/ (the same size as the slot)
